exposure: Intrapartum FHR beat-to-beat variability (within normal range)
outcome: Umbilical cord arterial blood gas parameters (pH < 7.2 for acidosis)
cohort: The study included 120 women with term (>=37 weeks), singleton pregnancies who were candidates for vaginal delivery.
finding: Reduced FHR beat-to-beat variability, even within normal limits, was significantly associated with neonatal acidosis (pH < 7.2) and lower Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean rates were significantly more frequent in neonates experiencing acidosis.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from medical records of deliveries between August and December 2022.
